description: This file defines authentication-related functions for login and registration, utilizing an API client for backend communication. It includes type definitions for credentials and registration data, and provides fallback mock responses if API calls fail.

methods.name: loginRequest
methods.description: Performs user login by sending credentials to the backend and handles failures with a mock response.

methods.name: registerRequest
methods.description: Performs user registration by sending registration data to the backend and handles failures with a mock response.
